143005.caption: Commander, why do you look so pale? I see, so your computer bluescreened... Don't worry, I can fix it right away. Have some coffee and relax, I'm sure the documents will all be intact.

143006.caption: It's been a while, Commander. I'm sure that as I am now, I'll be able to solve many more problems for you. Awaiting your command.

143007.caption: SOP-II, stop doing the hundred-meter dash in the base corridors! And 15, don't think I don't know you've been secretly drinking the whisky that M16 left behind! Both of you, learn the dorm rules already!

143008.caption: Peaceful days like this don't come by often... No Dolls with their heads stuck in strange places, no animal hordes escaping the Rescue Station, and no tricky emergency missions... I'm actually not too used to this.

143009.caption: Objective sighted, carry out elimination orders at once.

143010.caption: Commander, have you been pulling an all-nighter again? Wait, there are Dolls looking... Oh all right, on account of how hard you've been working, I'll let you hold me like this for a while.

143011.caption: I'm sure you have your reasons for choosing me...<>But, please don't stand so close, because everyone...everyone's watching... I'm so embarrassed!

143013.caption: Commander, there are still some documents which require your inspection... I've also sorted out the personal letters from the other Dolls and left them on your table.
